proc sanitise(s: string; maxLen = 4000): string {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Keeps tabs/newlines, printable ASCII and high bytes (assumed UTF-8); replaces other control bytes with '?'. Falls back to pure ASCII if the result is not valid UTF-8, so output is always safe to serialise as JSON. 
proc sliceAt(buf: string; a, b: int): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Bounds-checked slice; returns "" when out of range. 
proc textOrNull(s: string; maxLen = 300): JsonNode {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Returns the sanitised string if the payload looks like text (>=70% textual bytes), else JSON null. Binary blobs (EXIF, thumbnails, ...) report size only via the surrounding object.
